entries.label: Local source view labels; local reading does not authorize model disclosure

en.title: Referenced conversation sources

en.readonly: This source message is a version-pinned, read-only view. Editing, restoring a stored version and source-history sending are unavailable.

en.details: Source versions, access results and read evidence
en.unavailable: The source view is unavailable. Stored messages and explicit source statuses remain visible.
en.none: Do not create a content index
en.retention: These are the currently resolved resource-read settings. A transient read does not remove earlier snapshots or certify absence of historical payload.
en.configuration_unavailable: Read configuration is unavailable; inspect diagnostics before reading.
en.empty: The recognized source has no messages.
en.install: Install local-source view labels in this profile
en.feature_missing: This profile has no accepted local-source view catalog. Installing its declaration preserves existing settings and exclusions.
en.host_unavailable: This host exposes stored messages only. Reading linked source history is unavailable.
en.decoded_projection: Text and summaries are decoded display projections. Numeric tokens in unknown fields may be rounded here. Inspect the exact native response in source evidence.
en.wire_unavailable: Exact native response evidence is unavailable for this host response.

entries.label: Entries of the + menu next to the message field (attach, model, tools, context, import)

value.note: Entries of the + menu next to the message field. label/reason name a word of presentation.ui_shell, or are {en, pl}. kind: attach (file picker), camera (photo: the camera on a phone, a picture file elsewhere), model (list of models; the choice is written to the conversation level of the scope chain under default_model, the key the kernel reads), submenu (items), toggle (on until turned off, a chip above the field says so: `field` + `value` = the request field it sets while on, e.g. web_search: true, deep_research: true, reasoning_effort: high, action: agent.run; or `flag` = a switch of this view: memory | knowledge), panel (opens a panel: import | graph | settings), unavailable (visible, with reason). exclusive: turning it on turns off the other field switches (an action takes only the words, no files). needs: settings that must not be empty, else the entry is unavailable with `reason` (and `panel` where they are set).

entries.label: Your own changes to the + menu: hide, add, reorder

value.note: Your changes to the + menu, applied in order to the entries: {op: hide, id} | {op: add, item, parent?, before?} | {op: move, id, before?|parent?} . Empty = the menu as shipped.

en.help.2: Every row is a node of one graph: its chip says which level gave the value, the evidence says whether it is a preset, something you said or an inference. Collapsed rows are only hidden by the budget.
en.help.3: The graph is computed on demand from what the app already has; nothing is written to it by looking. Perspectives choose other edges than the containment; the budget per level is the setting “Node budget per level” (Settings › Interface); what you hid stays countable.

entries.label: Words of the human settings screen (M1-W0: groups, fields in words, the filter, the write level); texts only, they change nothing that is sent

en.title: Settings
en.intro: Eight human groups. Every field has a name, a why, its value in words and a chip that says who set it.
en.filter.changed_none: You changed nothing in this group: everything is a preset.
en.filter.changed_none_all: You changed nothing: every value is a preset.
en.set_for.note: The default level of a write from this list; a field's card asks “For whom?” with the levels of that field.
en.set_for.no_conversation: without an open conversation a write “for this conversation” has nothing to write to
en.all_fields.note: Today's field table and the JSON editor “Expert configuration” — nothing disappears.
en.roles.show: Show the roles (who does which job)
en.roles.title: Roles: who does which job
en.roles.note: The semantic-analysis model is not a knob in this group: it is the role “Background analysis” — its card shows the chain, the class, the flow and every flow that reads it.
en.unavailable: This host has no settings.resolved action yet: {{reason}}
en.sum: {{n}} fields in all: {{fields}} from the settings description and {{profile}} runtime profile values (chip “runtime profile”).
en.levels.title: Levels (where a value comes from)
en.levels.note: Every value comes from one level of the chain; a field's card shows the whole chain with the level that supplied it.
en.yours.note: “Yours” counts values that differ from the preset; a preset stored in your settings is not your choice.

pl.title: Ustawienia
pl.intro: Osiem grup po ludzku. Każde pole ma nazwę, „po co”, wartość słowami i chip, który mówi, kto ją ustawił.
pl.filter.changed_none: Nic nie zmieniłeś w tej grupie: wszystko jest presetem.
pl.filter.changed_none_all: Nic nie zmieniłeś: wszystkie wartości to presety.
pl.set_for.note: Domyślny poziom zapisu z tej listy; w karcie pola „Dla kogo?” pokazuje poziomy tego pola.
pl.set_for.no_conversation: bez otwartej rozmowy zapis „dla tej rozmowy” nie ma do czego pisać
pl.field.flows_none: Żaden przepływ jeszcze tego nie czyta.
pl.all_fields.note: Dzisiejsza tabela pól i edytor JSON „Konfiguracja ekspercka” — nic nie znika.
pl.roles.title: Role: kto wykonuje którą pracę
pl.roles.note: Model do analizy semantycznej nie jest gałką w tej grupie: to rola „Analiza w tle” — jej karta pokazuje łańcuch, klasę, przepływ i każdy przepływ, który ją czyta.

pl.sum: Razem {{n}} pól: {{fields}} z opisu ustawień i {{profile}} wartości profili runtime (chip „profil runtime”).
pl.levels.title: Poziomy (skąd jest wartość)
pl.levels.note: Każda wartość pochodzi z jednego poziomu łańcucha; karta pola pokazuje cały łańcuch z poziomem, który dał wartość.
pl.yours.note: „Twoje” liczy wartości, które różnią się od presetu; preset zapisany w Twoich ustawieniach nie jest Twoim wyborem.
